description: Contest an active decision: it stops governing immediately, without deleting it or requiring a replacement.

evidence_ref.description: Source ref for evidence that contradicts the decision. Attaches an evidence node and a contradicts edge, which raises the gap_scan finding from `contested` to `contested_with_evidence`.

id.description: Existing active decision id to contest.

reason.description: Why the decision is being contested. This is what an adjudicator reads.

name: decision_contest
